content: For this open-source npm/local CLI bridge, maintainability requirements should center on one canonical contract source, docs that match shipped behavior, reproducible tests for installers and host registration, explicit Node/platform prerequisites, upgrade/uninstall/recovery instructions, and release metadata checked in CI. This is primarily an ecosystem-maintenance inference grounded in the repository's current docs, package allowlist, host-specific installers, zero-runtime-dependency constraint, and CI/Changesets workflow; no single authoritative source defines a product-specific table-stakes list. Treat exact installer security and documentation policy as phase-specific follow-up, with high confidence only for keeping behavior/docs/tests synchronized as a requirement.
